purpose: Structured memory of modelling lines previously judged unsuccessful under their stated scope. Entries do not ban retesting the same model or logic. A retest must record why the prior result may be non-generalizable or unreliable and must use an independent verification design.

prior_lines.reason: Repeated exploration exhausted without robust VAL/OOS improvement.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: A genuinely new causal raw source changes the information set.
A different causal market-structure target, not another momentum threshold.
A new independently validated risk signal and full sizing-chain parity.

prior_lines.scope: Funding spike contrarian and basis-carry/funding-floor strategies
prior_lines.retest_guidance: A new raw source with known availability lag; record why funding-only retuning is now informative.

prior_lines.scope: Macro, TradFi, and paid intraday equity/futures overlays
prior_lines.reason: Free calendar signal failed validation; paid-data increment is unproven.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: Independent evidence of incremental causal information before purchase or integration.

prior_lines.reason: Four rounds closed; no robust result.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: New forward-collected microstructure or fill data is the strongest differentiation; otherwise document the retest cause.

prior_lines.scope: Exit logic, TP/SL width, quality threshold, time exit, and second-slot tuning on an unchanged signal
prior_lines.reason: 21+ exit rounds and related sweeps did not survive validation/OOS.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: A new entry signal or an independently reproduced execution discrepancy makes a full-stack retest informative.

prior_lines.scope: BTC causalfix/unified 5m triple-barrier quality-direction classifier family
prior_lines.reason: Event geometry, model family, feature unions, TP-first labels, and barrier/horizon calibration all failed VAL/OOS gates.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: Different causal raw information and a different decision objective are strong reasons; otherwise reproduce the prior result first.

prior_lines.scope: BTC direction/PnL from the Rho1 cross-asset panel and ranking head
prior_lines.reason: Panel calibration improved, but rank score was near constant and all Fresh-Forward PnL settings were negative.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: A non-directional use with a separately pre-registered execution hypothesis is a meaningful differentiation.

prior_lines.scope: DVOL level/change feature overlay on the BTC quality classifier
prior_lines.reason: 0/9 configurations; features were used by the model but worsened OOS in most comparison cells.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: Option skew or term-structure data with independently verified availability is a strong differentiation.

prior_lines.scope: JEPA/temporal-contrastive embedding on the current unified raw panel
prior_lines.reason: 0/9; learned embeddings ranked below their raw inputs.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: Different raw modality or downstream task is a strong differentiation; document why a capacity-only retest is informative if used.

prior_lines.reason: 0/24; P(TP)-P(SL) showed no monotonic realized-quality ranking.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: Different causal information and decision target are strong differentiators; otherwise document the independent reproduction plan.

prior_lines.scope: BTC triple-barrier horizon and fixed TP/SL multiplier sweep
prior_lines.reason: 0/148 configurations passed both VAL and OOS.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: A validated new signal is a strong reason; otherwise state the corrected assumption behind recalibration.

prior_lines.reason: Three seeds were OOS-negative and model-family changes did not alter the result.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: A new validated supervised signal or different action space should include seed-diversity and fresh-forward evidence.

prior_lines.scope: Frozen Sigma3 1h entry with mechanical 5m barrier-resolution exit
prior_lines.reason: Observed OOS improved but a genuinely fresh window reversed sharply negative.
prior_lines.retest_guidance: A different entry signal or a diagnosed execution-parity error should be verified on untouched data.
